name: misteralg
description: MisterALG: interpretador, editor e depurador de Portugol para Windows, macOS e Linux, inspirado no VisuAlg

scripts.test: npm run test:codificacao && npm run test:interpreter && npm run test:busca && npm run test:app && npm run test:interpretador-c && npm run test:compat && npm run test:interpretador-js && npm run test:interpretador-python && npm run test:interpretador-csharp && npm run test:interpretador-sql
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && node scripts/preparar-linguagens.mjs && npm run dist:mac -w misteralg-app
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && node scripts/preparar-linguagens.mjs && npm run dist:win -w misteralg-app
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && node scripts/preparar-linguagens.mjs && npm run dist:linux -w misteralg-app
